invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new list, and the collect(Collectors.toList()) never returns null.
The result list is constructed by filtering out nulls from the intermediate stream, so there are no nulls in result.
The deduplication process groups and reduces records, so there cannot be more records in the result than the input.
All elements in the result stream are filtered to be non-null before collection.
Parallelism is likely expected to be at least 1, as 0 parallelism does not make sense in execution and would likely cause error upstream.
